title: OpenCode file browser settings
description: Settings for the opencode-filebrowser TUI plugin. Stored at ~/.config/opencode/filebrowser.json (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/filebrowser.json). Every field is optional; an unknown or malformed value falls back to its default without discarding the rest of the file.

root.description: Which directory the browser may show and how far it may navigate.

mode.description: session: the directory of the active session. path: the configured path. unrestricted: the configured path or the session directory, with no containment check.

path.description: Directory used by the path and unrestricted modes. A leading ~ is expanded.

allowAbove.description: Allow navigating above the configured root.

style.description: nerdfont requires a patched font; unicode is the portable fallback.

enabled.description: Colour and badge entries by git status.

badges.description: Show the porcelain status badge next to an entry.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for git status before giving up.

palette.description: Colour scheme for file states. jetbrains: modified blue, untracked red-brown, added green. vscode: modified amber, untracked green.

showUnpushed.description: Mark files changed by commits that are not on the upstream yet with ↑.

collapsedByDefault.description: Start the sidebar section collapsed the first time it is shown; afterwards the last state is remembered.

maxRows.description: Tree rows shown in the sidebar before it scrolls.

ignore.description: Names or basename globs to hide. A trailing slash restricts the rule to directories.

enabled.description: Refresh the tree when the filesystem changes.

debounceMs.description: Quiet period before a filesystem change triggers a refresh.

default.description: Provider id used when no mapping matches. Built-ins are plaintext and readonly.

maxInlineBytes.description: Largest file the inline editor will load; larger files open read-only.

map.description: Ordered basename globs mapped onto an editor provider.

provider.description: Provider id, either a built-in or one declared under providers.

providers.description: External editor providers, keyed by the id used in map and default.

module.description: An npm package name or an absolute path to a local module.

options.description: Options passed through to the provider unchanged.

command.description: Keymap command dispatched for a binary file, normally provided by opencode-file-viewer.

fallback.description: Ordered fallbacks when the command is unavailable.

items.description: system-open hands the file to the OS; hex shows an explanatory message; none does nothing.

protect.description: Globs that require a confirmation before a file is opened. ** spans path separators.

confirmOverwrite.description: Ask before a paste replaces an existing file.

keybinds.description: Informational keybinding labels shown in the footer. The bindings themselves are fixed and listed in the README.
